result.requirement: The system shall validate regulatory compliance and contractual terms to authorize new Store Partners for platform operations.
result.business_need: The business needs this to ensure all partners operate legally within defined zones and adhere to agreed financial and service standards before accepting orders.
functional_behaviour: The system shall collect and verify regulatory licenses, permits, and zone-specific compliance data submitted by the Store Partner.
The system shall validate the Store Partner Agreement details, including commission rates, liability clauses, and performance guarantees.
The system shall confirm the Store Partner is located within an active Service Area Definition before granting operational access.
The system shall generate a unique identifier and activate the partner status only after all validation checks pass successfully.
The system shall log all verification results and approval decisions for audit and regulatory reporting purposes.
related_information_requirements: Current records of licenses, permits, and regulatory adherence regarding food safety, labor laws, and data privacy.
Precise geographic coordinates or polygon boundaries defining authorized operating zones.
Legally binding contractual details including commission rates, payout schedules, and liability clauses.
Status of the data link between the store's Point of Sale and the platform.
business_rules: A Store Partner cannot be activated until valid regulatory licenses are verified for the specific operating zone.
Operational access is restricted to partners whose locations fall strictly within an active Service Area Definition.
The system must reject onboarding requests where the Store Partner Agreement lacks defined performance guarantees or liability clauses.
Regulatory Authority must have the ability to override or suspend partner status based on compliance violations.

acceptance_criteria.given: A new Store Partner submits a complete application with valid licenses and a signed agreement.
acceptance_criteria.when: The Platform Operator initiates the validation process.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system verifies all documents, confirms the location is within a Service Area Definition, and activates the partner status.

acceptance_criteria.given: A Store Partner submits an application missing a required food safety permit for the target zone.
acceptance_criteria.when: The system runs the compliance validation check.
acceptance_criteria.then: The system rejects the onboarding request and generates a Dispute Ticket detailing the missing regulatory requirement.
